info.title: BRASPACE API
info.description: Lunar landing site comparison and launch-delay replanning (NASA Space Apps 2026). Visibility is geometric line of sight computed by the Rust engine from stored horizon and Sun/Earth series. Check `science_status`, `provenance` and `scientifically_validated` on every response; synthetic fixtures are not NASA data.

get.summary: Terrain horizon and Sun/Earth azimuth/elevation for one site (stored series values, read-only, never interpolated)

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: RFC3339 UTC on the series grid; default is the series start

parameters.name: step
parameters.description: Seconds between samples; whole multiple of the series step (default: series step). At most 1000 samples are returned.

404.description: Unknown site (SITE_NOT_FOUND) or site without series (NO_SERIES_DATA)

422.description: INVALID_TIME, INVALID_DURATION, INVALID_STEP, GRID_NOT_ALIGNED, OUTSIDE_COVERAGE or WINDOW_TOO_LONG

Direction.description: Degrees in the local MOON_ME topocentric convention used by the engine.

data_source.description: Where the catalog and series were loaded from at startup

role.description: e.g. feature_center; never a touchdown point

ScienceStatus.description: Status of the stored horizon/ephemeris series.

series_sha256.description: SHA-256 of series_file; the file is rejected at load if it does not match

SiteSummary.description: `series` is present only when visibility data exists for the site.

distance_km.description: Great-circle distance between feature centers on a 1737.4 km sphere

Metrics.description: Fractions are 0..1 of samples; hours have one-step resolution; margins in degrees above the terrain horizon.

SiteResult.description: No numbers are returned unless data_status is AVAILABLE.

Constraints.description: Caller-declared assumptions; at least one is required. No defaults are applied.

margin.description: Positive = slack, negative = breached by this amount

observer_height_m.description: Must equal the height the stored horizon was computed for

aboard_during_delay.description: Crew consumes stock while waiting out a delay

rate_source.description: Required citation for the consumption rates

Crew.description: Caller-declared crew and consumables; no defaults.

margin_hours.description: autonomy minus window length; negative = runs out before the end

OnboardRisk.description: Same shape as the onboard simulator (#70) risks.

Consumables.description: UNKNOWN when no crew was declared.

OnboardPower.description: Passed unchanged to the onboard simulator (#70).

combined_decision.description: Energy, comms AND consumables must hold; first passing candidate in request order.

onboard.description: Unmodified response of the onboard simulator (#70), braspace.onboard-simulator.v1

registry_ref.description: Entry in the team asset registry or NASA manifest this layer is copied from

source_url.description: Original https URL; the only URL the asset proxy will fetch

delivery.description: proxy = same-origin copy at asset_path; external = link to source_url only

MediaCard.description: Link to an original LROC page; no image is copied.

VisibilityRequest.description: Caller-supplied inputs; identifiers are not verified.
